warnings.message: Card-pattern suggestions are experimental behavioral reviews, separate from Upload-v8 alerts. They do not change model decisions or fraud metrics, and do not identify counterfeit cards or establish fraud.

Upload-v8 is an experimental synthetic model using frozen thresholds. Matching fields do not establish validity for this upload's source. Review means a model alert; approve means no alert, not a payment authorization. No automatic blocking. Raw model margins are not probabilities. Legacy rule thresholds and device/location baselines do not affect scoring.

Features use only this submitted history. Confirmed delayed merchant-fraud feedback is unavailable and encoded as zero support. Short histories and missing merchant geography may reduce performance. Synthetic benchmark metrics do not describe this upload.
Features use strictly earlier events. Equal-time events cannot influence each other. Completion status updates future spending history; current labels are excluded from inference.
